annotations.title: Turn a website into an API

description: TURNS A WEBSITE INTO A CALLABLE API (named functions with inputs, returning JSON), built by the caller in a real browser. url = the page that already shows the rows (search results or a listing, not the home page); goal = the inputs and fields wanted. The call first proposes the user's matching saved workflows and marketplace APIs (skip_existing / skip_marketplace build fresh), then opens a cloud browser bound to the build: capture_network records the site's own calls, writ_browser_network reads them, api_call probes them; a failed probe is evidence, not the end. Functions: HTTP flows first (writ_browser_compose define_function `flow`; writ_help('http_flows')), single requests (from_index) mixed in, DOM extraction last. writ_browser_save, then run_example on two inputs. mode=intelligent: Writ builds it alone (+ writ_discovery_status wait=true), on request.

mode.description: guided (default: the caller drives) | intelligent (Writ builds it alone, on request) | auto | fast | crawl | browser.

skip_existing.description: Skip the proposal of the user's own matching workflows.
